entities.name: Cisco
entities.gloss: An American multinational technology conglomerate corporation that develops and sells networking hardware, software, and telecommunications equipment.

entities.name: Cisco Discovery Protocol
entities.gloss: A proprietary Data Link Layer network protocol developed by Cisco Systems used to share information about other directly connected Cisco equipment.

entities.name: CDPwn
entities.gloss: A set of five critical vulnerabilities discovered in the Cisco Discovery Protocol implementation across various Cisco devices.

entities.name: CVE-2020-3120
entities.gloss: A denial-of-service vulnerability in the Cisco Discovery Protocol implementation of Cisco FXOS, IOS XR, and NX-OS Software.

entities.name: CVE-2020-3119
entities.gloss: A stack overflow vulnerability in the Cisco Discovery Protocol implementation of Cisco NX-OS Software allowing remote code execution.

entities.name: CVE-2020-3118
entities.gloss: A stack overflow vulnerability in the Cisco Discovery Protocol implementation of Cisco IOS XR Software allowing remote code execution.

entities.name: CVE-2020-3111
entities.gloss: A remote code execution and denial-of-service vulnerability in the Cisco Discovery Protocol implementation of Cisco IP Phones.

entities.name: CVE-2020-3110
entities.gloss: A remote code execution and denial-of-service vulnerability in the Cisco Discovery Protocol implementation of Cisco Video Surveillance 8000 Series IP Cameras.

entities.name: Cisco FXOS
entities.gloss: An operating system developed by Cisco Systems for its Firepower security appliances.

entities.name: Cisco IOS XR
entities.gloss: A train of Cisco Systems' network operating systems designed for service provider routers.

entities.name: Cisco NX-OS
entities.gloss: A network operating system developed by Cisco Systems for Nexus series Ethernet switches and MDS series storage area networking switches.

entities.name: IP-телефон Cisco IP
entities.gloss: A line of voice-over-IP telephone hardware devices manufactured by Cisco Systems.

entities.name: IP-камери Cisco для відеоспостереження серії 8000
entities.gloss: A series of network-connected surveillance video cameras produced by Cisco Systems.
